decision.explanation: Multiple documents provide distinct yet overlapping accounts of Thomas Rich’s military rank. Document D1S2 explicitly states he held the rank of 'Admiral,' while D2S2 claims he held the rank of 'Chief of Artillery.' Further, D1S8 specifies additional naval ranks—'Rear-Admiral of the Blue' (1794), 'Vice-Admiral of the Red' (1799)—and D1S11 notes 'Admiral of the Blue' (1801). These are distinct valid referents and complementary descriptions of his career progression. All are supported directly by the original sources and should be preserved.
